_doc: Per-reference corrections to the automated probe. Each entry records a metric the probe measures wrongly on that site, why, and the visual evidence that settles it. Overrides suppress a metric; they never assert a pass.

area17.reason: The probe's brand heuristic picks the leftmost interactive element inside the measured <header>, but AREA 17's brand mark is an oversized graphic that overflows the rail and is not among the header's interactive children. The probe therefore reports the first NAV LINK (x=942 at 1440) as the brand. evidence/area17/desktop-initial.png shows the actual mark at x=16, which is what the reconstruction renders.

studiofreight.reason: At tablet and mobile the reference header exposes exactly one detectable interactive element (the logo) - its menu control is not an <a>/<button>/[role=button], so the probe's rightmost-interactive figure is the logo's right edge (x=36) rather than the real trailing control. End-gutter is therefore not comparable at those two viewports. Desktop and laptop end-gutter remain enforced.
